name: Dame x Prince
source:
Players play as Ani, a princess of the small but peaceful country of Inako. Ani visits the religious and powerful country of Serenfaren to attend a peace treaty signing ceremony between Serenfaren and the military country of Mildonia. The ceremony was supposed to end without incident, but the princes of both countries are all idiosyncratic and hard to deal with. 

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2017-07-23/dame-prince-smartphone-game-gets-tv-anime-in-january-2018/.119211]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
玩家將扮演小而和平的伊納科王國公主艾妮。艾妮前往宗教勢力強大的塞漣法連，參加塞漣法連與軍事國家米歷德尼亞之間的和平條約簽署儀式。儀式本應順利結束，但兩國王子都性格古怪、難以應付。

[來源：[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2017-07-23/dame-prince-smartphone-game-gets-tv-anime-in-january-2018/.119211]Anime News Network[/url]]
